summary.text: Wood Armor is Bi Chen Tian's immortal killer move. He used it to carve dao marks in his body so his defenses are naturally strong.

claims.text: Inside Reverse Flow River, where Gu worms hibernate and cannot be summoned, the rank eight wood path Gu Immortal Bi Chen Tian fights Fang Yuan with body and close combat alone. Reviewing why a rank seven should not match him, he lists grass python Immortal Gu for strength, this wood armor, a wood heart, and green blood for healing, together with the dao marks of a rank eight who has passed many calamities and tribulations. He still finds himself only evenly matched, which shocks him.

Duke Long’s useful defensive killer moves are like the wood armor Bi Chen Tian was so proud of. That type of killer move turns into dao marks engraved on the Gu Immortal’s body. The marks stay dormant, and when attacked they activate themselves, needing no thought to manipulate, only immortal essence. Ghostly Concealment is much more refined than Bi Chen Tian’s wood armor, or Duke Long’s and Purple Mountain True Monarch’s defensive methods of this kind, because ghostly concealment stays active all the time and costs no immortal essence.
